public_repository_status: Public unauthenticated GitHub API returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-11; this script builds the local release package for upload.
new_intervals: Descriptive unadjusted percentile bootstraps over held-out subjects, conditional on fitted predictions.
generator_fit_scope: Only the two-parameter affine calibration baseline, fitted on training subjects in each LOSO fold; no original classical/GRU refits.

additional_fixed_baselines_and_residual_.new_baseline_fitted: One affine OLS calibration correction in each of 15 LOSO folds; no tuning or blending.

calibration_correction.fit: Equal-session OLS from avatar-calibration mean to full online-session mean, using 98 sessions of 14 training subjects only.
calibration_correction.held_out_information: Avatar-calibration mean only; coefficients and forecasts shared across anchors and horizons.
calibration_correction.holm_family: All 18 correction-versus-context/expanding tests; separate from the earlier fixed-baseline family.

additional_fixed_baselines_and_residual_.baseline_target_views: Fixed predictions evaluated once on the raw-score scale; residual conversion does not add a comparison.
additional_fixed_baselines_and_residual_.expanding_mean_information: Online blocks 0 through anchor, including blocks preceding the original ten-block context.
additional_fixed_baselines_and_residual_.residual_diagnostic: Pearson correlation within sessions, arithmetic session means within subjects, equal-subject mean; descriptive, no significance test.
additional_fixed_baselines_and_residual_.interval_scope: Unadjusted descriptive subject percentiles; conditional on saved fits; shared LOSO training and overlapping windows remain limitations.
additional_fixed_baselines_and_residual_.calibration_threshold: In-sample reference: avatar blocks also contribute to calibration prototypes; no future online blocks are used.
additional_fixed_baselines_and_residual_.verification: Original context MAEs and all 1950 learned-model subject MAEs reproduced at absolute tolerance 1e-12; all archived targets and keys matched.
